# Component snippets

One `.html` file per component — the **ready-to-copy markup**, with all the
showcase page scaffolding stripped out.

## How to use

1. Make sure your page loads the bundle:
   ```html
   <link rel="stylesheet" href="../zego-ds.css">
   <script src="../zego-ds.js" defer></script>
   ```
2. Open the snippet for the component you want (e.g. `button.html`), copy the
   markup, and paste it into your page.
3. Edit the text/values freely.

Notes:
- Some snippets show a few **variants** (e.g. default / disabled) so you can
  see the options — just copy the one you need.
- Any `<div class="row">` you see is only a spacing wrapper from the examples;
  it isn't part of the component and can be dropped.
- Styling and behaviour come from the bundle, so you don't copy any CSS or JS —
  just the HTML.
